title: Pullover Machine
summary: A machine pullover that loads the lats evenly from full stretch to the hips, with no balancing.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for lats (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.25 for triceps (minor): each working set adds 0.25 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.2 for upper back: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.15 for chest: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly chest total.

setup.text: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot, and put your elbows on the pads.
Let the pads go back overhead until your lats are stretched.
Drive your elbows down to your sides, then return slowly.

form_cues.cue: Start with arms up behind you
Drive the elbows down toward your hips
Push through your elbows, not your hands.

mistakes.text: Pushing with the hands instead of driving through the elbows.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
